* [[Sikhanyiso Ndlovu]], the Information Minister of [[Zimbabwe]], calls [[Chancellor of Germany (1949–)|Chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]] of [[Germany]] a "[[Nazi]]". Ndlovu responded to the German government's criticism of rising [[Human rights in Zimbabwe|human rights abuses]] in Zimbabwe by telling Merkel to "shut up". [http://allafrica.com/stories/200712140740.html (allAfrica.com)]
